routing.gate: MERGE GATE (rulings GATE-SCOPE and R2): when the integration branch (PR #2015) merges to main, every row left has a removed_by starting with '59' (a shrink-only family row) and names a mechanism inherited unchanged from main and not mirrored in the compile.  Every other row goes before the merge, including every row for code #2015 adds and every row for a pass the compile mirrors; line 59 empties the list after the merge.  It covers route planning and emission: everything under layout/routing/, the planning modules port_order_plan.py, route_plan.py, route_reservations.py, fan_plans.py, route_topology.py, seam_topology.py, fan_geometry.py, fan_ordering.py, envelope_settlement.py and settlement_demand.py, and every render/ module, which routes the finished layout and settles its geometry.  It may only shrink.  removed_by names the #2094 list line or ruling that removes the entry, or 'unassigned'.  'entries' are detected by the guard; 'manual' are cases the AST cannot see, checked only by asserting that the named function exists, so deleting the function makes the entry stale.  'pinned_later_passes' and 'pinned_nested_passes' keep a route pass registered while anything calls it, whether or not the routing table runs it; a pin is valid to delete only when its pass has no callers left, and review checks that.
